source_review.notes: Checked Unicode 17.0 core material and UAX #29/#15/#31, the current Rust input-format contract, Python 3.14 lexical source rules, and the official LSP site/specification. Version-sensitive Unicode segmentation and protocol behavior are explicitly versioned.

evidence: Reviewed byte-boundary, half-open-span, decoder, line-start, position conversion, revision, and origin-relation notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: All coordinate systems name their unit; bounds and partiality are explicit; the origin relation correctly allows one-to-many mappings.

evidence: Executed source-position-model and matched 12-byte length, line starts 0/4/11, five coordinate tuples, and invalid offset 2.
Recomputed UTF-8, scalar, UTF-16, CRLF, and EOF examples independently.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Byte counts and UTF-16 supplementary-scalar counts agree across exposition, examples, exercises, and model output.

evidence: Re-derived predecessor line lookup from sorted starts.
Re-derived canonical byte to consumer-position conversion and partial inverse.
Checked revision-bound span and many-to-many origin obligations.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Derivations distinguish physical encoding boundaries from presentation and protocol policies.

evidence: Reviewed empty source, EOF, final newline, LF/CRLF/lone CR, continuation byte, UTF-16 surrogate split, combining sequences, ZWJ emoji, bidi controls, tabs, stale revisions, overlapping edits, malformed bytes, and long-line/resource cases.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Exact edits reject invalid boundaries; recovery and rendering policies are explicitly separated from compiler acceptance.

evidence: Traced source identity/revision, ordered in-bounds spans, encoding boundaries, newline policy, negotiated unit, origin provenance, round trips, and resource limits.
invariant_checking.notes: No stored byte span is dereferenced against a different revision and no display column is treated as a canonical storage coordinate.

evidence: Reviewed uniqueness of predecessor line lookup.
Reviewed round-trip obligation for valid boundaries.
Reviewed UTF-8 boundary argument and explicit limitation of the finite model.
proof_review.notes: Arguments state well-formedness, sorted-index, unit, and snapshot premises; they do not claim a complete Unicode decoder proof.

evidence: Audited every use of proof, invariant, property, model, and conformance language.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: The executable code is explicitly a restricted deterministic model; broader correctness is presented as test/proof obligations against versioned specifications.

evidence: Reviewed executable output, complexity statements, protocol-version statements, and all safety limitations.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Complexity follows the stated scan/binary-search algorithms; current claims are specification-backed. No performance benchmark, clinical validation, or external review claim is made.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed distinctions among bytes, code units, scalars, graphemes, glyphs, display cells, normalization, source identity, revisions, line indexes, protocol positions, and expansion origins.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed strict and recovery decoding, immutable snapshots, LSP conversion, incremental edits, safe terminal rendering, generator provenance, fuzzing, and production resource limits. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from raw bytes through encoding and canonical spans to human/protocol positions; ten examples are distinct and five exercises progress to railway assurance transfer with complete answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
